subject: Dawnbringer
fact: Dawnbringer enjoys the open air of the Neverlight Grove, with its bright, cheery light and vibrant colors.
source_quote: Dawnbringer has been quite chatty of late. She enjoys the open air of the Neverlight Grove, with its bright, cheery light and vibrant colors.

subject: Basidia
fact: Basidia believes the best way for Myconids to work together is through a group meld where everyone can hear from everyone.
source_quote: They say, “Phylo is changing our society. I believed that the best way for us to work together was to participate in a group meld where everyone could hear from everyone.”

subject: Basidia
fact: Basidia sighed after describing Phylo’s influence on Myconid social structure.
source_quote: Basidia sighed, “Phylo said strange things like the need to eliminate cross-functional groups and instead have teams focused on the task at hand.”

subject: Hepbobe
fact: Hepbobe is a sentient Myconid who insists they are not mushrooms but a special kind of sentient species.
source_quote: It’s a typical misconception of softers who think all mushrooms are just that, mushrooms. We are a special kind of mushroom, or more precisely, we are not mushrooms because we are a sentient species.

subject: Hepbobe
fact: Hepbobe showed the irrigation tunnels and various fungi grown to feed the colony.
source_quote: He shows the irrigation tunnels and the various kinds of fungi that are grown, “To continuously feed and delight the Myconids that live in this community.”

subject: Hepbobe
fact: Hepbobe offered to give a detailed analysis of crop yields but sensed boredom and declined.
source_quote: I could give you a detailed analysis of our crop yields and growth, but perhaps another time.

subject: Hepbobe
fact: Hepbobe believes organizational structures are meaningless to those who have a job to do maintaining the farming supply.
source_quote: Those of us who have a job to do to maintain the farming supply do not think that this is meaningful one way or another.

subject: Hepbobe
fact: Hepbobe became animated arguing that Phylo’s proposal might lead to a better day for Myconid Kind.
source_quote: What if there is a better day for Myconid Kind?

subject: Yrberop’s song
fact: The melody Yrberop sings is identical to the one heard when seeing Zuggtmoy in a dream, but its meaning is unverified.
source_quote: It’s the same melody that we heard when we saw Zuggtmoy in his dream. It has no rhythm, no beauty, it revels in a symphony of chaos and evil. It hurts.

subject: Yrberop
fact: Yrberop declared that all Myconids are necessary for Phylo’s great plan and the Great Seeder who is coming.
source_quote: Welcome, have you come to see the all that Myconids that will be? They are all necessary for Phylo’s great plan and the Greet Seeder who is coming!

subject: Rasharoo
fact: Rasharoo believes the natural state of a Myconid is nomadic, not sedentary cultivation.
source_quote: The myconid is a nomad.

subject: Rasharoo
fact: Rasharoo revealed escape routes and nutrient caches in case the Myconids need to flee.
source_quote: I have a few escape routes and nutrient caches should we ever need to flee.

subject: Rasharoo
fact: Rasharoo expressed disgust at the plan to go to the Overbrite, arguing Myconids thrive in the dark.
source_quote: That would be a terrible idea. Myconids thrive in the dark. Why would we go into the light of the Overbrite?

subject: Rasharoo
fact: Rasharoo believes the caves and tunnels are another Myconid that connects everything, and Myconids are messages for it.
source_quote: I think the caves and tunnels are really another Myconid that connects everything. And that we are messages for that myconid.

subject: Rasharoo
fact: Rasharoo offered to send the party through a secret passageway into the Circle of Welcome.
source_quote: If you wish, I could send you into the Circle of Welcome through a secret passageway.

subject: Xinaya
fact: Xinaya, once a Drow, begged to be killed after being infected by Phylo’s spores and transformed into a fungal host.
source_quote: Please, for the love of your gods of light, kill me.

subject: Xinaya
fact: Xinaya was sent by Ilvara to capture the party but was corrupted after accepting Phylo’s invitation to the Circle of Welcome.
source_quote: I was given orders to capture you. I came here, thinking you would seek refuge amongst the Myconids. But I made the mistake of accepting Phylo’s invitation to see the Circle of Welcome.

subject: Xinaya
fact: Xinaya warned the party of the Demon Queen of the Fungi in the Underdark.
source_quote: You must warn the other Drow of the presence of the Demon Queen of the Fungi in the Underdark.

subject: Fungal Abomination
fact: The fungal abomination gurgled and spoke in mind and voice, inviting travelers to the wedding rehearsal of the Great Seeder and the Great Body.
source_quote: Are you here for the wedding rehearsal? Friends of the bride or her intended? No matter! Let the love of the Great Seeder embrace you as you become one with her chosen, the Great Body!

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin noticed Jimjar covered in spores and stop moving.
source_quote: I see to my left Jimjar covered in spores, and then he stops moving.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz fired a fire mote that exploded in a conflagration, triggering more corpse explosions.
source_quote: Just then, a corpse explodes, and the bloody parts somehow cure the abomination. ... And then boom, as the fire mote flies from Daz’s hand and explodes in a conflagration of fire.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz giggled after killing Myconids with his bolts.
source_quote: Meanwhile, Jimjar kills poor Sarith. And then I distinctly notice Daz giggling.

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith’s head exploded and turned into a Drow spore servant.
source_quote: And to my horror, Sarith’s head explodes and turns into yet another Drow spore servant.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir killed the fungal abomination.
source_quote: Zalthir strikes the fungal abomination, killing it.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar killed Sarith after Sarith became a spore servant.
source_quote: Meanwhile, Jimjar kills poor Sarith.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin asked Xinaya if she was okay with being killed, and she said yes.
source_quote: Thorin marches up to her, talks to Dawnbringer about the kindness of the gesture, Dawnbringer agrees, and Xinaya is killed. ... “I asked, and she said okay. We’re an arranged marriage.”

subject: Jimjar’s silence on betting
fact: Jimjar has not made a bet in some time and seems to know about the wedding, but his awareness and motives are unexplained.
source_quote: I don’t see the point in making a bet. Everyone is so happy about this wedding.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin recognized the music Yrberop sang as the same melody from Zuggtmoy’s dream.
source_quote: But Thorin does, it’s the same melody that we heard when we saw Zuggtmoy in his dream.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir noted the curious sight of a Myconid dancing and agreed with Thorin’s observation.
source_quote: Zalthir notes how curious it is curious to see a Myconid dance. I agree.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir asked Basidia if Hepbobe’s food supply had evil spores and received a negative answer.
source_quote: Zalthir asks Basidia whether Hebopbe’s food supply has the evil spores, and they say no.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin declared that Yrberop’s cult is a death cult.
source_quote: Thorin turns to me, “This is a death cult.”

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin heard the lyrics of Yrberop’s song about the Great Seeder’s wedding to the Great Body.
source_quote: I can hear the music. ... Yrberop, that’s the Myconid’s name, is singing about some Great Seeder, and her “wedding” to the Great Body...

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum used a guiding bolt to wound a Myconid and watched Daz kill others.
source_quote: Using a guiding bolt, I wound one of the remaining Myconids. And watch as Daz’s bolts kill them.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum nodded in agreement that arranged marriages can work very well.
source_quote: I nod, “Arranged marriages can work very well!”

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum asked if Hepbobe was a mushroom that eats other mushrooms, revealing a common misconception.
source_quote: Grygum awkwardly asks, “So wait, you are mushrooms, like the food, and you eat other mushrooms?”

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum realized that Myconids are fungus that eat fungi, just as he is a mammal that eats animals.
source_quote: I think I got it and ask, “So you are a fungus and eat fungi, just like I am a mammal and eat animals.”

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum followed the path toward the giant mushroom after the battle.
source_quote: Up ahead, we see a path that leads to the giant mushroom, and I think, why not?

subject: Daz
fact: Daz calculated and executed an explosion that triggered a chain reaction of corpse explosions and acid drenching.
source_quote: I know what is coming next. “Boom.” ... And then another corpse explodes, drenching us all in acid.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin realized the bright light from Dawnbringer hurt the fungal creatures as if it were sunlight.
source_quote: And the bright light emanating from the shift hurts the creatures as if it were from the sun itself.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin thought he dodged a bullet with Zalthir after Sarith’s head exploded.
source_quote: I think to myself that I dodged a bullet there with Z.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir questioned Xinaya’s survival after she was wounded and appeared close to death.
source_quote: Zalthir looks confused, “Is she okay with it?”

subject: Xinaya
fact: Xinaya screamed about how life sucks, showing emotional distress before her death.
source_quote: I look at Xinaya and notice that she is crying. So close to liberation and yet so far. And scream about how life sucks. She does a lot of that.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir noticed Jimjar had not made a bet in some time and asked Basidia if he was infected.
source_quote: I notice that Jimjar has not made a bet in some time. I ask Basidia if he has been infected and they say no.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir showed true Drow instincts by wanting to question Xinaya instead of killing her immediately.
source_quote: Thorin wants to do as she asks, but Zalthir shows true Drow instincts when he wants to ask questions.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz shouted for others to get out of the way before detonating a fire mote.
source_quote: Daz shouts, “If you can get out of the way.”

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin realized the Myconid’s song had no rhythm or beauty, only chaos and evil, and it hurt.
source_quote: It has no rhythm, no beauty, it revels in a symphony of chaos and evil. It hurts.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin concluded that the Myconid cult was a death cult, though its members believed it brought joy.
source_quote: And then I remember that they don’t think it is a death cult, instead they assume it is a cult that will bring them some great joy.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin recognized the music as the same melody from Zuggtmoy’s dream and understood its significance.
source_quote: But Thorin does, it’s the same melody that we heard when we saw Zuggtmoy in his dream.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum concluded that Myconids are sentient fungi who eat fungi, just as he is a mammal who eats animals.
source_quote: So you are a fungus and eat fungi, just like I am a mammal and eat animals.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin realized that the Myconids’ belief in a better day contradicts the horror of their transformation.
source_quote: What if there is a better day for Myconid Kind?

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir expressed fear of mind infection and rejection of becoming a zombie.
source_quote: I will not have my mind infected by these things. I will not become a zombie …

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin acknowledged that many death cults exist because their followers believe they are bringing joy, not death.
source_quote: And then I remember that they don’t think it is a death cult, instead they assume it is a cult that will bring them some great joy.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir noticed Rasharoo’s nervous energy and frantic voice during their conversation.
source_quote: I notice that there is some nervous energy, a hastiness about them. There is something different. His voice is frantic and full of speed.

subject: Rasharoo
fact: Rasharoo claimed Myconids are messages for a greater Myconid that connects the tunnels and caves.
source_quote: I think the caves and tunnels are really another Myconid that connects everything. And that we are messages for that myconid.

subject: Xinaya
fact: Xinaya revealed that Ilvara wanted to kill the party herself, but sent Xinaya to capture them.
source_quote: Ilvara wanted to kill you herself. I was given orders to capture you.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz’s fire mote explosion triggered another corpse explosion that drenched the party in acid.
source_quote: And then another corpse explodes, drenching us all in acid.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin realized the spore cloud covering them was a weapon of the fungal abomination.
source_quote: And a spore cloud covers us all.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir killed the last Myconid creature after Grygum and Daz wounded others.
source_quote: Zalthir kills the last of the Myconid creatures.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin observed that the Myconid’s song and the music from Zuggtmoy’s dream were the same, confirming a connection to evil.
source_quote: It’s the same melody that we heard when we saw Zuggtmoy in his dream.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum concluded that Myconids are not just mushrooms but a sentient species with unique preferences and cooking styles.
source_quote: We are a special kind of mushroom, or more precisely, we are not mushrooms because we are a sentient species.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir noted that Rasharoo’s belief in nomadic Myconids contradicts the norm of sedentary cultivation.
source_quote: Basidia, if they could roll their eyes, would. “No, Rasharoo is one of our kind who is always exploring. That is why they are exploring. Myconids stay in one place and cultivate their gardens.”

subject: Daz
fact: Daz’s explosion triggered a chain of corpse explosions that cured the abomination before drenching the party in acid.
source_quote: Just then, a corpse explodes, and the bloody parts somehow cure the abomination. ... And then another corpse explodes, drenching us all in acid.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin realized the Myconid’s wedding ritual is a deception masking a death cult.
source_quote: This is a death cult.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir questioned why Jimjar had stopped making bets, sensing something was wrong.
source_quote: I wonder why he must have known about this wedding. And he does look worried.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin recognized that the Drow’s plea for death was a sign of corruption, not weakness.
source_quote: Please, for the love of your gods of light, kill me.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum used a guiding bolt to wound a Myconid during the battle.
source_quote: Using a guiding bolt, I wound one of the remaining Myconids.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz’s fire mote exploded in a conflagration, triggering multiple corpse explosions.
source_quote: And then boom, as the fire mote flies from Daz’s hand and explodes in a conflagration of fire.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin realized that the fungal abomination’s voice spoke both aloud and in the mind simultaneously.
source_quote: The aberrant myconid’s voice gurgles and spits as it speaks both aloud and in my mind simultaneously.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir killed the fungal abomination after it had been weakened by others.
source_quote: Zalthir strikes the fungal abomination, killing it.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin observed that the Myconid’s song was joined by the groaning of the Garden of Welcome’s heads.
source_quote: Echoes spill from the misty cavern beyond, a cacophony of wheezing voices that wrap together like some kind of discordant music. The remaining heads planted in the Garden of Welcome begin to croak and groan, joining the horrible song.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin noticed that the bright light from Dawnbringer hurt the fungal creatures as if it were sunlight.
source_quote: And the bright light emanating from the shift hurts the creatures as if it were from the sun itself.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir asked Xinaya if she was here to kill them, and was surprised by her answer.
source_quote: Zalthir asks if she was here to kill us. I stifle a laugh.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin realized the Myconid’s wedding was a ritual of transformation and absorption, not celebration.
source_quote: Let the love of the Great Seeder embrace you as you become one with her chosen, the Great Body!

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum concluded that Myconids are herbivores with specific preferences and cooking styles, like other creatures.
source_quote: Myconid’s are herbivores. Much like other creatures, we have particular preferences and cooking styles and ways of meeting, producing, and consuming the food that reflect the wide variety of tastes and pellets of the individual myconids.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin realized that Sarith’s transformation into a spore servant was a direct result of exposure.
source_quote: And to my horror, Sarith’s head explodes and turns into yet another Drow spore servant.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz’s explosion of fire and acid triggered a chain reaction of corpse detonations.
source_quote: Just then, a corpse explodes, and the bloody parts somehow cure the abomination. ... And then another corpse explodes, drenching us all in acid.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin realized the Myconid’s belief in a better day was a dangerous delusion masking horror.
source_quote: What if there is a better day for Myconid Kind?

source_quote: Zalthir asks Basidia whether Hebopbe’s food supply has the evil spores, and they say no.

source_quote: I nod, “Arranged marriages can work very well!”
